reason: E2 supports that SRO in MoNbTaW affects dislocation motion, but E1 describes SRO behavior in a completely different alloy system (CoNiV) and shows that low-temperature annealing increases SRO, not reduces it, directly contradicting the premise that ~800°C annealing reduces SRO without forming brittle phases.
